email_messages.subject: Fabrikam signage invoice PINV-104 - do not pay yet
email_messages.body:
AP team,

Holding Fabrikam Print & Signage invoice PINV-104 ($25,000.00). Half the trade-show panels arrived misprinted and we have asked Fabrikam for a corrected invoice plus a credit for the reprint. Dispute is open with their AR team as of today.

Please exclude PINV-104 from Friday's run. I'll confirm once they issue the credit - do not schedule it in the meantime.

Dana Whitfield, Marketing Ops (SIMULATION)
